intentAndPurpose.intent: Surface-aware list row with optional decorative start/end slots and structured title/support content or a custom content node. Four sizes, full-width/rounded layouts, condensed spacing, divider control, and idle/medium/high selection emphasis. `appearance="auto"` inherits a supported parent Surface appearance. Add `onPress` or `onClick` to make the complete row one accessible button.

props.name: size
props.description: Scales title/support typography, decorative slots, gaps, and default inline padding.

props.name: start
props.description: Decorative leading slot (normally Icon, Avatar, Image, or Badge). Hidden from accessibility and pointer events; a JDS Icon inherits the slot size and colour. — [warn] Use a display-only JDS component. Do not place an IconButton or another interactive control here; activate the complete row with `onPress`.

props.name: content
props.description: Main content. Prefer { title, secondaryText?, prefix? }; primitive title/support values supply the interactive accessible name. A custom ReactNode is also accepted but must provide `aria-label` when it cannot name the row.

props.name: end
props.description: Decorative trailing slot (normally a chevron Icon or non-interactive status). Hidden from accessibility and pointer events. — [warn] Do not put a nested action in `end`; it cannot receive pointer or accessibility interaction. Put the action on ListItem via `onPress`.

props.name: contentAlignment
props.description: Vertical alignment of the start slot and main content.

props.name: type
props.description: Edge-to-edge row or fixed-width inset row with tokenized rounded corners.

props.name: selectedState
props.description: Selection emphasis. `medium` uses a minimal/subtle tint; `high` uses the appearance role bold surface and on-bold content colours.

props.name: showDivider
props.description: Shows the inset bottom Divider. React Native cannot infer the last sibling; set false on the final row when the list should have no trailing divider.

props.name: condensed
props.description: Uses tighter tokenized vertical padding while preserving the row accessibility target.

props.name: leftPadding
props.description: Logical start-padding override. `true` and `margin` both use the responsive spacing-margin token; omit for the size default.

props.name: rightPadding
props.description: Logical end-padding override. `true` and `margin` both use the responsive spacing-margin token; omit for the size default.

props.name: appearance
props.description: `auto` inherits a supported parent Surface appearance and otherwise resolves to primary. Controls selection fill, content, divider, and press-state paint.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks activation, applies disabled opacity, and exposes accessibilityState.disabled.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Primary React Native press handler. Takes precedence over `onClick`.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Web-parity fallback press handler, used only when `onPress` is absent.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible-name override. Required for an interactive row whose content is custom/non-textual; otherwise primitive structured title/support text supplies the name.

props.name: accessibilityHint
props.description: Describes the result of activating an interactive row.

props.name: style
props.description: Additional native ViewStyle, merged last. Use for layout overrides only. — [warn] Do not paint the row directly. Use `selectedState`, `appearance`, and a parent <Container>/<Surface> so content and interaction colours remain context-aware.

props.name: testID
props.description: React Native test identifier applied to the root View/Pressable.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: [error] Don't paint directly. Use `appearance` (role) + `variant`/`mode` and wrap in <Surface mode>; the brand cascade picks the right fill.
